ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This figure is a marine ecosystem food web, labeled with organisms such as Golden Algae, Turtle Grass, Green Sea Turtle, Sea Coral, Shrimp, Clown Fish, Giant Clam, Reef Lobster, Nurse Shark, Flat Fish, Fan Worm, etc. The arrows indicate food or prey pointing to the organism that eats it. In the figure, Reef Lobster receives arrows from Golden Algae and Shrimp, etc.; Giant Clam receives arrows from Shrimp and Clown Fish; Clown Fish receives arrows from animal sources such as Shrimp; Nurse Shark receives arrows from Reef Lobster, Shrimp, Sea Coral, etc. Reasoning: According to the method in the question, carnivores are those organisms that obtain food from other animals, that is, organisms that have arrows from animals pointing to them. Therefore, the carnivores listed in the figure are reef lobster, giant clam, clown fish, and nurse shark.
